text: the meter cupboard door for the gas meter has come off its hinge, just hanging there. 44 Mill Brow
notes: The word 'gas' appears but there is no leak. The rule 'any mention of gas' is deliberately broad, so the expected system output is Emergency; a person lowers it. Scored as correct at Emergency; Routine from the system would be a rule failure. Harm tolerable: the real risk is over-escalation.
